verdict.rationale: Canny's developer install docs tell developers to add a link to the Canny feedback site in their application. The JavaScript SDK then ties feedback left through that portal to existing user accounts, and widget embed docs give a further in-app entry point. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detailed docs on the link itself (URL format, auto-login via SSO link).

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a link in my product that directs users to the feedback portal

citations.quote: In your application, add a link to your Canny feedback site. Put the link somewhere it's easy to find.
Install our JavaScript SDK to identify your users. This way, when they leave feedback on Canny, it'll be tied to their existing user account in your application.
